newMoon.name: New Moon
newMoon.description: The lunar cycle begins while the illuminated side is nearly invisible from Earth.

waxingCrescent.name: Waxing Crescent
waxingCrescent.description: After the new moon, the illuminated portion grows a little each evening.

firstQuarter.name: First Quarter
firstQuarter.description: The Moon is about a quarter through its cycle and half of its disc is visible.

waxingGibbous.name: Waxing Gibbous
waxingGibbous.description: More than half of the disc is lit as the Moon continues toward fullness.

fullMoon.name: Full Moon
fullMoon.description: The side of the Moon facing Earth is almost completely illuminated.

waningGibbous.name: Waning Gibbous
waningGibbous.description: After the full moon, the illuminated portion of the disc gradually decreases.

lastQuarter.name: Last Quarter
lastQuarter.description: The Moon is about three quarters through its cycle and half of its disc is visible again.

waningCrescent.name: Waning Crescent
waningCrescent.description: A thin crescent shrinks as the cycle approaches the next new moon.
